topRepository.name: Honeymoon-in-Morocco
topRepository.description: Honeymoon trip must be romantic. A trip that perhaps, might not be the first one with your partner, but trip that is very special as it is the first journey as husband and wife eloping into the marriage. Most people might have different ideas, but it should be romantic, relaxing, splurging and exploring. Honeymoon is about doing things together. It might be simple tasks such as relaxing, reading books, sunbathing or more active as exploring old sights, trekking, cooking lessons and much more. Honeymoon trip to Morocco offers all that and even more. Morocco is a perfect destination for honeymoon. It is few of the places in the world that still keeps all its charm of a bygone era while allowing 21st century technology to exist alongside. This exotic country with distinct climate conditions, stunning natural beauty, Sahara caravans and curvaceous dunes will definitely leave you enchanted with the romantic charm. On your Morocco honeymoon tour enjoy the stay in luxurious and authentic riads with superb accommodation. Hotel Mamounia is a world known hotel that many people talk about. The luxury of this hotel, food and gardens will leave you in wonder. But there are many other riads in the old part of towns, medina to hotels in the new part of cities. The traditional riads offer tranquility and many hidden nooks where couple can enjoy each other company, the exotic decoration, tranquility of it all. There are plenty of activities and places to explore on your honeymoon to Morocco. We recommend trip to the Morocco Sahara Desert. Loose yourself in the romance in dreamy nights under the starts on the Sahara desert. Other possibility is a Morocco tour to the Atlas Mountains where you can sip a glass of mint tea on the terrace of Kasbah Tamadot with one of kind views of the Atlas Mountains. The other alternative on your honeymoon journey to Morocco is to relax in many of the beautiful gardens such as the Marjorelle Gardens in Marrakech, or shop in the souks of the old medinas, enjoy the local spas or take a hot air balloon ride. From gorgeous riads, through the exciting food and amazing culture visiting Morocco as part of your honeymoon trip will stay with you for lifetime.
